Dear Ms Siegal,



I am contacting you from the Daily Mail in London in the hope that you may be able to put some allegations to Jeffrey
Epstein.



I am dealing with a 2009 deposition from Juan Alessi. Mr Epstein's former maintenance worker at his Palm Beach
residence. Mr Alessi details how the residence was 'like a hotel' with celebrities passing through including Prince Andrew
and Sarah Ferguson.



He said between 50 and 100 people came to give massages at the house and were paid S100 for an hour-long massage.



He said pictures ofnaked women were on display by the pool, while other witnesses have described nude photographs of
underage girls on a staircase.



Mr Alessi said Ghislaine Maxwell kept a laundry basket of sex toys and a black costume in a cupboard.



I know that Mr Epstein's lawyers were present as the evidence was given on 8 September 2009. If he would care to
respond, I'd be grateful.



Please confirm receipt of this email and feel free to contact me on the phone number is below.



Kind regards.
